purpose: Verified-at-runtime API facts for wiring scored_runner.py (F8). Every item below was executed against the real modules, not inferred.

bar_adapters.canonical_store: gitignored data_raw/forex_free_v1/{TAG}_1h_*_a.json windows; td_loader.load_pair_h1(pair, data_root, request_manifest) -> (rows, quarantined); rows use key 'datetime' = 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (naive UTC string) and string prices
bar_adapters.family1_rows: family1.load_bars requires {'timestamp': ISO-8601 UTC AWARE string (e.g. datetime.fromisoformat(dt).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat()), 'open','high','low','close': REAL NUMBERS (strings rejected)}; returns tuple[Bar,...]
bar_adapters.family2_rows: family2.load_bars requires {'datetime': tz-AWARE ISO (naive rejected by _parse_utc), prices as floats per _as_finite_float}; returns BarSeries; same canonical rows converted with .isoformat() aware form

run_arm.tier_semantics: cost = 1.5 bps/side x tier on EVERY fill; tier 2.0 additionally applies the frozen one-event entry delay
run_arm.delay_param: NOT a parameter; tier 2.0 implies S3 delay inside the modules

family1_result_shapes.fills: list of {trade_id: 'anchor|PAIR|YYYY-MM-DD', role: 'ENTRY'|'FLATTEN', instant: ISO string, price: float, side: 'BUY'|'SELL', cost_bps: float}
family1_result_shapes.cashflows: list of {trade_id, position: +1/-1, entry_instant, exit_instant, gross_return_frac, cost_frac, net_return_frac} — one per trade; net_return_frac x NOTIONAL = net PnL
family1_result_shapes.trade_grouping: fills group by trade_id; cashflows already per-trade (preferred extraction source)

family2_result_shapes.cashflows: list of {arm_id, pair, day: 'YYYY-MM-DD', gross_ret, cost_ret, net_ret} — per-trade net returns
family2_result_shapes.fills: per-fill records (entry/exit) with own fields; extraction uses cashflows for PnL and fills for timestamps if needed
family2_result_shapes.arm_registry: family2.ARM_IDS + family2.arm_identity(arm_id) -> sha256 digest; ARM_REGISTRY/ArmSpec(arm_id, tz, tz_name, anchor_hour, direction_multiplier)

family1_arm_configs: family1.frozen_arm_configs() -> anchor/neighbour/control; neighbour differs by session_zone (America/New_York vs Europe/London); control carries position_sign -1
scoring_gate: family1.run_arm returns 'scoring_authorized': False (hard-coded at family1.py:718 in dry-run context). BEFORE any scored cell, locate the documented authorization mechanism (grep scoring_authorized family*.py fully) and set it through that mechanism only; the runner must refuse to publish a cell whose run reports scoring_authorized false.

runner_design_frozen.folds: 3 equal chronological thirds by exit instant
runner_design_frozen.cell: family x arm across 7 pairs; pnl per trade = net_return_frac (family-specific) x 10000
runner_design_frozen.metrics: after-cost expectancy/trade, position PF, per-fold pnl/expectancy/pf/positive, MDD on cumulative chronological pnl, pair/fold concentration of positive pnl
runner_design_frozen.stage_a_gates: expectancy>0, PF>=1.10, >=2/3 folds positive, no fold PF<0.80, MDD<=12% of notional, no fold >50% of positive pnl, no pair >40%
runner_design_frozen.accounting: observed counter +1 per computed cell before publication; publication idempotent by cell digest; replay adds nothing
runner_design_frozen.stress_axes: cost tiers x{1,1.5,2} (+delay at top), drop-one-pair, drop-one-fold
